reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Four Treasure-Seekers and the frame in The Loyal Mungoose; the frame (the poor man's wife telling her husband) is stated correctly and omitted with disclosure.

Copper, silver and gold are found in turn; the fourth friend's wheel, King Vinavatsa and Rama's time follow the source. Ryder's dripping blood is dropped with disclosure; the wearer only says it hurts.
Kubera is named only by the old wheel-bearer as hearsay, not by the narrator; the four friends' Brahman caste is dropped with disclosure.

Age band 10+: nobody dies, but the greedy friend is left under the wheel as the consequence of his greed. Fixed before approval: the content note no longer implies he is freed later, and the dialogue at the wheel names its speakers. The retelling stops at the scolding that names The Lion-Makers (story 24).
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; seams measured at x=512 and y=512/1024; painted to every edge with no text.

One generation and two edit passes: the first removed a second quill from the copper-finder, an axle stub touching the head, and the screaming and grimacing faces; the second, after review, removed a fifth quill from the magician's hand. The coordinator counted exactly four quills, one per friend, in the final panel 1.

The wheel floats clear above each wearer's head in panels 4 to 6; no contact, blood, wound or grimace of pain is drawn. Panel 5 shows astonishment and panel 6 quiet shame, with the gold-finder in tears.
Shawl colours and bundles are consistent; no caste markers, deities or modern objects. Accepted: the old wheel-bearer is drawn gaunt.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children or parents.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.

Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol (gpt-6.1-sol is not available to this account) and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
